text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
After high knees, squats, and lunges, we 
do 40 sets of 100m sprints.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...That's a pretty demanding routine, 
isn't it?
choice_data_list:
We'll train your muscles thoroughly and 
evenly

text_block_list.text:
Her sudden exhaustion at the Derby. If 
it's a skeletal issue, building up muscle 
to compensate should solve it.

Since there are no target races right 
around the corner, now's the time to cut 
straight to the core issues.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: OK! Zero objections. Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Haa... hoh... fuh, fuh...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa~... Training with something that 
heavy.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My! Are you interested in Kura-chan's 
training too, Vi-chan?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I have a matching ball myself. 
Would you like to give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? N-No way, I'll pass. Just holding 
that for a bit gets me exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Still.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Satono, are you training with that too?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because my debut race is coming up in 
the autumn.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I can finally stand on the starting line 
too. ...Finally. Just like the older girls 
of the Satono family.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... In that case, let's see! Just like 
Satono, I'm making my debut in the autumn 
too!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Satono. Could you... lend me that 
ball after all?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Sounds wonderful♪ Let's go train 
that core of yours!

"This summer, Satono Crown isn't the only 
one; there are plenty of Umamusume 
striving to rebuild and retrain their 
bodies."

Summer training camp is a time to prepare 
to spread your wings toward the next 
stage. After all, that's a shared 
understanding everyone has.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...*nibble*. ...*munch*.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what did you say we were doing for 
our next training session again?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Beach sprints and a 15km open-water swim! 
It's brutal... but we just gotta do it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —Kh!? *Gasp*!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Sorry about that. Here, have some 
water.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Kita-chan! I heard! You're running 
in the Kikuka Sho, right?!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah... Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...Even though Duramente-san won't be 
able to run anymore, that is."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...? Why does Duramente's name come up 
there?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh? W-Well... I mean, Duramente is 
practically just like Teio, isn't she?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Besides, in my generation, there's a girl 
who's so super dazzling and charismatic, 
just like Teio-san.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"All the other girls are able to show 
everyone their dreams. Compared to them, 
I'm just—"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—We are lacking in every single 
department.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Abilities. Aptitude. ...Even mindset. 
Compared to a true star, I—!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Still, the one I'm dreaming on is you, 
Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I dunno about anyone else, but... I want 
Kita-chan to be my star!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
As you probably know, I couldn't run in 
the Kikuka Sho because of my injury, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Seizing the victory that had once slipped 
away, the Umamusume who wins the Kikuka 
Sho is—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —I'm hoping it's you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand besides! Even if you look up to me, 
simply copying the exact same wins is 
kinda... boring!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If someone's gonna do it, I'd rather they 
pull off what the "Emperor" couldn't... 
That way, it makes me feel even greater!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah. In that case, I kinda want them to win 
both the Tenno Sho (Spring) and the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn)~. Is that being too greedy?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Teio-san.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... In short, Kita-chan...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You're a star too.

—It happened when we had finished our 
training for the day and were heading back 
to the training camp lodge.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Kitasan?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, um.
choice_data_list:
Shall we invite Kitasan along before we 
go?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Just to be safe, you know. 
Though I'm sure she's planning to pack it 
in soon anyway.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan! Time for you to head home too! 
It's almost dinner time!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...! Kura-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No problem, no problem! I'll be totally 
back right before it starts!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Really? It doesn't look that way to 
me, though—"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—I'm serious. So don't stop me, Kura-chan. 
I am going to surpass all of you.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I want to become someone who can carry 
what needs to be carried."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...So I'm sorry. Let me push myself hard 
tonight!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Kitasan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...They left.
choice_data_list:
...They shook us off with everything they 
had.

...They shook us off with everything they 
had.

No matter what I said, that stubbornness 
wouldn't budge, you know.

No matter what I said, that stubbornness 
wouldn't budge, I'm telling you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...They left.
choice_data_list:
...They shook us off with everything they 
had.

...They shook us off with everything they 
had.

No matter what I said, that stubbornness 
wouldn't budge, you know.

No matter what I said, that stubbornness 
wouldn't budge, I'm telling you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, if we chased after them, it'd 
probably just backfire on us."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Besides—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Because I can understand the feeling of 
wanting to carry something on your 
shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
We will inform the dorm heads and 
instructors ourselves. ...So that we do 
not get in that girl's way.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes. I imagine that was the case.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Let's head back to the training camp 
lodge first and let the dorm head and 
instructors know."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like that's the least I should do 
as a friend, at least."
choice_data_list: Got it, I'll pass it along for you.
Got it, I'll pass it along for you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Thank you. ......

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ! I'm sorry. That's—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...It was the first time I'd ever seen 
Kitasan look like that."
